d: Captain's room. Early morning. Captain in a chair in front of a mirror. Wozzeck shaves the captain.
Free field, the city in the distance. Late afternoon. Wozzeck and Andres cut sticks in the bushes.
Marie's room. Evening. Military music approaches. Marie with her child by her arm by the window.
Doctor's study room. Sunny afternoon. Wozzeck enters. The doctor rushes hastily towards Wozzeck.
Street in front of Mary's door, dusk.
Mary's room. Morning, sunshine. Marie, her child on the lap, holds a piece of mirror in her hand and looks into it.
Street in the city. Day. The captain and the doctor meet.
Street in front of Marie's apartment door. Day by day. Marie stands at her door. Wozzeck quickly arrives at her on the sidewalk.
Wirtshausgarten. Late in the evening. The inn music on the stage just finished the Ländler of the orchestra prelude. Boys, soldiers and maids on the dance floor, partly dancing, partly watching.
Wachstube in the barracks. At night. Wordless choir of the sleeping soldiers, at first with closed curtain. Andres lies with Wozzeck on a platform and sleeps.
Mary's room. It's night. Candlelight. Marie sitting at the table, leafing in the Bible; the child nearby. She reads in the Bible
Forest path by the pond. It darkens. Marie comes with Wozzeck from the right.
A gift. Night. Weak light. Dirnen, among them Margret, and boys dance a wild fast polka. Wozzeck sits at one of the tables.
Forest path at the pond. Moon night as before. Wozzeck comes quickly waved up. Stays searching standing.
Street in front of Mary's door. Bright morning. Sunshine. Children play and noise. Mary's boy riding on a horse.
